## Session Brief

* [C1: an outcome-independent channel combine, and Neyman re-measured with it](C1.md) - Replace combine_kept's point-weighted branch (and pooled_scale's weights) with a combination fixed independently of the run's outcomes, state the fixed-budget path's transformation class, and re-measure the CLI's Neyman target mode and the BlockAllocation::Neyman figures.
* [P1: does Neyman allocation let budget reach the floor-bound channels?](P1.md) - Add an allocation knob to probe_2to6_budget_ladder, then run bbx_to_ccx_emmm_qcd0 at 600k and 1.2M over 20 seeds under ByAlpha and Neyman on one tree, and read the rungs as paired per-seed differences.

## Session Report

* [C1 report: channel terms are plain means of their iterations; Neyman's bbx gain was the combine, its target-mode gain is small and real](C1-report.md) - combine_kept and pooled_scale now take the plain mean of a channel's kept iterations whatever counts they drew. Replayed on P1's traces it removes Neyman's bias (paired t −2.40/−2.77 → −0.35/−0.22) at no variance cost on the α arm; the α-share weights the brief proposed are the plain mean exactly. The fixed-budget path is statistically gated: 18 banked cells and 8 long-tier MLM cells moved, all keep their status, pp_to_ll_0j2j_mlm @2 by +0.18% (pull +1.90 → +2.08). On p p > l+ l- j (6 channels) at a 0.179% target Neyman stops after 1.49M evaluations against ByAlpha's 1.58M over 20 paired seeds, the same before and after the change.
* [P1 report: Neyman's ladder passes only through its biased iteration weights](P1-report.md) - On bbx_to_ccx_emmm_qcd0, 20 paired seeds at 600k and 1.2M, Neyman reads seed sd 2.71e-9 → 1.76e-9 (ratio 0.65) with χ²/dof 1.14 / 0.76, against ByAlpha's 2.69e-9 → 3.34e-9. But it sits 1.7e-9 and 2.4e-9 pb below ByAlpha (paired t −2.4, −2.8), and recombining its own iterations as a plain mean removes both the shift (t −0.3) and the gain (ratio 1.18, χ²/dof 1.51 / 1.67). The point-weighted combine, whose weights Neyman sets from earlier iterations, down-weights tail iterations: variance bought with bias. Neyman moves no budget above the floors, and 551–575 of 615 channels still draw identical points at both rungs.
